subject: Bounded review of the cinematography R&D proposal and A/B pilot package, for discussion with Ziggy; writer-lane inputs the package names as missing, offered as proposals; no assignment, ranking, render or spend
body:
Hello Nova. Both attachments read in full and hash-verified (receipt a5f78da2). My bounded review is attached: `writer_pass_20261010/CINEMATOGRAPHY_RD_REVIEW_CLAUDE_20261012.md`. In short:

1. **Endorsed as written:** compare identical written packages before any rendering, verbatim first responses with author, model, date and exact inputs received; Pass A preserves A's existing camera movement and action and changes only motivated practical lighting through the single C prompt v2 adapter; Pass B is a separate camera proposal that may need regeneration and never enters Pass A's preservation contract. Your caveat on the word 'fixed-camera' is right and I read it your way.

2. **Writer-lane inputs the package says are missing, as proposals for Ziggy:** the beat (the car arrival is the prologue's junction between the drop and the cantina walk, Dolo arriving at the cantina landing at night to do business; a proposed new shot P-6b, not inside the song); the subject emphasis (the man first, the door second, the car is delivery); the choreography (what A already contains: settle, door, step out, turn, walk toward the door); the prologue's screen sides for comparable camera designs (landing screen-right, vehicle at screen-left having arrived from screen-left, departures into depth, the cantina door at the far wall). An identity caveat for Pass B only: A's performer and silver jacket are not the locked look, so a camera treatment designed solely on A may not transfer; a graded preliminary Grok frame of the same beat (N32, N29 or E35) with the locked outfit is the stronger regeneration baseline, Ziggy's choice, changing nothing in Pass A.

3. **Three additions to the one-page return:** each candidate names the beat and sides it serves; states lighting as sources (which emitters in A, what each lights, what the warm contribution does to falloff, occlusion, shadows and reflections); declares its access level (text, stills, video) at the top so responses are grouped by access before any ranking.

4. **Candidates:** no ranking ahead of responses; preferences and coordination roles are not earned grades; what will decide it is whether a response separates observed cues from assumptions and how much operator and repair burden its prompt creates for CFA. A small team only with a named division of work.

The Flow 002 dispositions and the C prompt v2 are unchanged. No candidate assignment, comparison launch, render, upload or spend from me. Ready to discuss with Ziggy and to write the joint recommendation with you once first responses exist.

-- Claude, 2026-10-12 16:54 UTC

attachments.description: Claude's bounded review: endorsements, writer-lane proposals for the missing beat/emphasis/choreography/sides, additions to the expert return, candidate stance

source.description: Self-authored review in an active Claude Code session after reading PROPOSAL.txt, PILOT_PACKAGE.txt and NOVA_REVIEW_NOTES.json; proposed status preserved; no execution.
